findings.title: Dartmouth Hitchcock Clinics Cheshire permanently closes Winchester Family Medicine location on November 6
findings.exact_supporting_passage: This clinic will be closing on November 6, 2026.
findings.access_consequences: Winchester primary-care practice location permanently closes as its sole provider departs. Existing patients must transition to another primary care provider; Dartmouth Hitchcock Clinics Cheshire says it will propose replacements and notify patients. Other family-medicine locations are listed in Keene and Walpole.
findings.affected_population: Existing patients of Dartmouth Hitchcock Clinics Cheshire Winchester Family Medicine; patient count not stated.
findings.evidence_notes: Provider's page does not disclose its own publication date. October 14 is the date of the initial patient notification letter, not a verified web publication date. Exact hour of clinic closure is unspecified. Newly found by supplementary recall; no direct production record check.
